verdict.rationale: Wise's own Balance Statement API lets developers retrieve account statements in accounting-friendly formats (CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF). That covers the 'view accounting data' half of the story through the product's API. Nothing in the pack shows a dedicated accounting API for managing ledgers, categorizing transactions, reconciliation, or syncing with accounting software. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting API, write/manage operations on accounting data, accounting-software integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage accounting data through a dedicated API

citations.quote: Statements can be retrieved in multiple formats: JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, or QIF.
